vo_lines: You streaming eight hours on launch night? Don't scrub the VOD.
Klipit finds every crazy moment and cuts the clips for you.
Subscribe at klip it dot on render dot com. Scan the code.
caption: GTA 6 community, this one's for you. Streaming 8 hours on launch night? Don't scrub the VOD. Paste your link into Klipit and it finds every crazy moment and cuts vertical clips for Reels and Shorts. Subscribe at klipit.onrender.com or scan the QR. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games.

shot_prompts.strip: street-level night shot down the middle of a neon tropical city boulevard like Vice City, palm trees, pink and cyan neon signs, wet asphalt reflecting lights, sports cars speeding past on both sides with long motion-blur light trails, empty center lane in the foreground, cinematic GTA vibe
shot_prompts.track: underground night street race on a neon-lit coastal causeway, two supercars launching side by side with tire smoke and headlights, crowd silhouettes along the barriers, empty asphalt in the foreground, magenta and cyan glow, GTA cinematic
shot_prompts.bridge: low angle night shot on an elevated highway above a neon tropical skyline, rain-slick road, streaks of red tail lights racing into the distance, palm trees, moody cyan and pink sky
